rows.ja: ホスティングの供給元

relations.text: Amazonとの商業契約を更新できない場合、サムサラはConnected Operations Platformを別のホスティング先で設定し直す必要がある
relations.text_en: If Samsara cannot renew its commercial agreement with Amazon, it would have to set up its Connected Operations Platform on an alternative hosting service.

source.label: Samsara 10-K
source.quote: If Amazon decided to compete with us and did not allow us to renew our commercial agreement, this may have a significant impact on our solution and would require that we allocate time and expense to setting up our Connected Operations Platform on an alternative hosting service.
source.note: リスク説明の中での記載です。

source.label: Samsara 10-K
source.quote: Our primary competitors include vendors like Avigilon, CalAmp, Fleet Complete, Geotab, Lytx, Masternaut, Michelin, Motive, Nauto, Netradyne, Omnitracs, Orbcomm, Platform Science, Skybitz, Spireon, TrackUnit, Verizon Connect, Webfleet, and Zonar.
source.note: Verizon Connectという事業の記載です。
source.note_en: Refers to the Verizon Connect business.

relations.text: サムサラとElement Fleet Managementが、車両・業務管理の共同提供を発表した
relations.text_en: Samsara and Element Fleet Management announced a holistic fleet and operations management offering

source.label: Samsara の発表
source.quote: Samsara Inc. ("Samsara") (NYSE: IOT), the pioneer of the Connected Operations® Platform, and Element Fleet Management Corp. ("Element") (TSX: EFN), the largest publicly traded, pure-play automotive fleet manager in the world, today announced a holistic fleet and operations management offering.

relations.text: サムサラがVolkswagen Group Info Servicesとの協業を発表し、フォルクスワーゲン各ブランドの車両データをSamsaraに連携できるとした
relations.text_en: Samsara announced a strategic collaboration with Volkswagen Group Info Services AG, connecting vehicle data from Volkswagen group brands into the Samsara Platform

source.label: Samsara の発表
source.quote: today announced a strategic collaboration with Volkswagen Group Info Services AG. This integration enables fleet operators to connect vehicle data from Volkswagen Passenger Cars, Volkswagen Commercial Vehicles, Audi, Škoda, SEAT, and Cupra directly into the Samsara Platform.
source.note: 子会社Volkswagen Group Info Servicesとの協業です。
source.note_en: Collaboration with subsidiary Volkswagen Group Info Services AG.

relations.text: サムサラがMercedes-Benz Connectivity Servicesの車両データAPIとの直接連携を発表した
relations.text_en: Samsara announced a direct integration with the Mercedes-Benz Connectivity Services vehicle data APIs

source.label: Samsara の発表
source.quote: today announced a direct integration between the Samsara platform and the Mercedes-Benz Connectivity Services vehicle data APIs. This partnership provides European fleets with turnkey access to Mercedes-Benz vehicle data streamed directly to the Samsara platform.

relations.text: サムサラがMobilisights経由でステランティスとの連携を拡大し、追加ハードなしで車両データを利用できるとした
relations.text_en: Samsara expanded its integration with Stellantis through Mobilisights, giving seamless access to vehicle data without additional hardware

source.label: Samsara company ブログ
source.quote: Samsara has announced an expansion of its integration efforts with vehicle manufacturer Stellantis through Mobilisights – the Stellantis Data as a Service Company – giving businesses across Europe seamless access to vehicle data without the need for additional hardware.
source.note: 同社ブログの記載で、データ子会社Mobilisights経由です。
source.note_en: Stated in Samsara's blog, via Stellantis data company Mobilisights.

relations.text: サムサラがAUMOVIOとの提携を発表した
relations.text_en: Samsara announced a partnership with AUMOVIO

source.label: Samsara の発表
source.quote: Samsara also announced a partnership with AUMOVIO

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
